comparison_rule: May be compared DIRECTIONALLY with the freeze-v3 run to ask whether findings replicated. Denominators must never be pooled: the two runs answer different question sets under different freezes.
why_not_current: The G1-completion mission expanded the corpus from 17 to 55 cases. The corpus is registered material, so the expansion required a new freeze (v3) and a new formal run. This run remains a valid preregistered result under freeze v2 and is preserved unmodified as the prior formal baseline.
